name: What preparation is needed before a kitchen trim installation crew arrives?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before a kitchen trim installation crew arrives?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before installers arrive, clear all countertop surfaces, empty upper cabinet items near work areas, and clear a wide walking path from the exterior door. Professional trim installation requires a dedicated staging area nearby, usually in a garage, patio, or driveway, for a miter saw stand and work tables. Ensure electrical outlets are accessible for air compressors and power tools. If you are supplying your own trim, verify that all profiles, inside corner blocks, and fasteners are delivered and inspected for shipping damage in advance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear all countertops, remove fragile items, provide an accessible staging area for saw cutting, and inspect all delivered trim pieces beforehand.
